raw_events.description: The complete signed event corpus. Implementations MUST derive dynamic validity and dispositions from these bytes; expected_report is an assertion, not an input to evaluation.

budget.description: A deterministic inclusive ceiling for all evidence-derived byte and item work, including ingress and dynamically traversed protocol evidence.

cancel_after.description: When non-null, request deterministic cancellation after this many charged work units. A value of zero stops before the first unit while preserving only already-conclusive output.

expected_report.description: The byte-exact canonical report assertion. Runners MUST NOT use this value to derive their actual result.
